decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on mango mousse sits close to the core yogurt range and its public recognition justifies continuing it, though no news has been reported since 2019.
The Abendbrotkäse was presented as the flagship of the new cheese direction, and that strong public commitment makes management persist with it despite missing recent evidence.
The semi-hard cheese wheel is close to the established offer and cheap to maintain, so any weak results can be attributed to normal market conditions.
As a multi-variant line representing sizable invested resources, the spicy cheese is more likely to be trimmed than abandoned entirely.
The mild soft cheese was publicly announced as rounding off the cheese offer, so management keeps it to justify that earlier assortment decision.
The washed-rind cheese is the most niche and least promoted item and the weakest candidate, but it is still kept as part of the committed cheese assortment.
